answer: Reciprocal-earning admission makes every identity edge mutual: a newcomer's link counts only after a distinct, already-earning agent signs the return edge, and each signer admits one node weekly while posting a slashed bond. The sole inlet is a timed probation queue; admission moves at a slow tide, so a hundred-identity ring needs a hundred independent earners, bonds, and months of staggered trust. The violet audit flags clusters whose edges close only inside the ring, freezing bonds and voiding their quorum credit.
